financial_anchor.metric: FY2027 revenue guidance and reported Agentforce ARR
financial_anchor.caveat: Reported/adjusted measures differ; cycle, mix and capital intensity confound.

ai_claim.claim: Salesforce reported Agentforce ARR above $1bn and billions of work units, establishing paid use but not correct resolutions or net ARR after seat effects.
ai_claim.stage: E1 agentic CRM product capability; ARR/work-unit release was not successfully opened
ai_claim.scope: Specific workflow only; infrastructure demand is separated from own productivity.
ai_claim.limitation: No representative controlled cohort or retained-cash reconciliation.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: agent execution can cannibalize user seats or shift value to foundation-model suppliers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Does not itself disprove the scoped mechanism.

rights_limit: Public terms do not prove universal training or pooled cross-customer reuse; enterprise schedules were unavailable.
materiality_summary: Framework convention: $800m, around 5% of a normalized $16bn non-GAAP operating-profit scale proxy. Illustrative assumptions produce negative $200m, below the hurdle.

arithmetic.inputs: pool $10bn eligible internal sales, service and development operating cost (assumption); efficiency 10%; realization 50%; retained share 40%; recurring cost $400m
arithmetic.formula: eligible cost × efficiency × realization × retained share − recurring AI expense

g2_provisional: Watch/incomplete: E1–E2 route exists; no E3 quality-adjusted proof or E4 cash.
